sentences.zh: 我是说，观众们都疯了。

sentences.en: I was over in the accounting nook.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And he's a super fit guy, but his arms, after take after take, started to shake.

sentences.zh: 他就是那种演员，你懂吗？

sentences.zh: 他觉得，如果我演的是吊杆操作员，我就要亲自举着吊杆。
